newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia says to expand China GSM network.
newsitem.headline: Nokia says to expand China GSM network.

text.p: Finnish telecommunications group Nokia Oy said in a statement on Wednesday it signed an agreement to expand the GSM-network of the Henan Post and Telecommunications Administration in China.
"The value of the contract is about 350 million markka ($71.4 million)," Nokia said.
"After the expansion, the Henan GSM network will have a capacity of 500,000 subscribers," it said.
Nokia delivered the initial GSM (Global System for Mobile Communications) network and a first expansion to Henan last year.

Deliveries of the "major" expansion will begin in the first quarter and the expansion will be taken into use in the autumn of 1997, Nokia said. It said it would bring increased capacity and enhanced coverage.
